caption: The video captures a near-stationary close view of a calm water surface used as a mirror, with a pale blue sky reflection filling most of the view. Soft grey cloud-like swirls cross the centre, a reddish-brown autumnal branch reflection hangs from the top, and a dark conifer reflection occupies the right edge. Throughout, the reflections continuously and subtly deform, wobble, and change extent. The wispy cloud reflection slowly reshapes and its swirl pattern drifts, while the darker shadow patch in the centre-left shifts slightly in position and form. The overall framing stays essentially constant, with the small pale double-stripe mark at the bottom-left remaining at nearly the same spot. A tiny bright speck near the centre persists with only minor jitter, holding roughly the same position. This is consistent with a largely fixed viewpoint while only the gentle surface movement quietly ripples the reflection.
